body.p: CLAIMLISTINGThis listing of claims will replace all prior versions and listings of claims in the application:

br.br:
1. (Original) A method of monitoring a user's breathing, the method comprising:passively monitoring the user's breathing with a device during a predetermined time interval generating sensor-generated signals, wherein the sensor-generated signals include at least one of acoustic signals or motion signals;
identifying one or more breathing modes of the user's breathing by processing data created from the sensor-generated signals using a machine learning model; and
responsive to detecting a trigger mode based on the identifying, generating an instruction adapted to the trigger mode and conveying the instruction to the user via the device.
2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the identifying is based, at least in part, on determining phases of the user's breathing, and wherein the determining comprises comprising:receiving acoustic signals generated by an acoustic sensor in response to the user's breathing;generating acoustic data comprising features extracted from the acoustic signals; andSVG {EMBED HERE} 0.0770.09
determining phases of the user's breathing by classifying the acoustic data using an additional machine learning model, wherein the additional machine learning model is trained based on signal processing of motion signals generated by a motion sensor in response to human breathing motions
3. (Original) The method of claim 2, wherein the machine learning model is trained by:obtaining acoustic training data created based on a series of sensor-generated acoustic signals generated in response to the breathing of one or more subjects; and
annotating the acoustic training data based on the signal processing of the motion signals;
wherein the motion signals are generated in response to the breathing of the one or more subjects and are generated simultaneously with generating the sensor-generated acoustic signals.
4. (Original) The method of claim 3, wherein the trigger mode corresponds to shallow breathing or mouth breathing by the user.
5. (Original) The method of claim 1, comprising:
identifying a breathing context of the user, wherein the breathing context of the user includes at least one of a physiological context, a psychological context, or a social context corresponding to the user; and
determining based on the breathing context at least one of a nudge to deliver to the user or a time for conveying a nudge to the user.
6. (Original) The method of claim 1, comprising:
capturing with the device a series of sensor-generated acoustic signals during the predetermined time interval; and
discarding one or more of the series of sensor-generated acoustic signals that are each identified as an unreliable signal;
wherein the identifying is based on a comparison of multiple phases of the user's breathing.
7. (Original) The method of claim 1, comprising:
conveying the instruction to the user via the device to perform a mindful breathing exercise in response to the identifying a trigger mode; and
providing auditory or visual biofeedback to the user via the device based on determining phases of the user's breathing as the user performs the mindful breathing exercise.
8. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, comprising:
identifying a breathing pattern of the user based on determining phases of the user's breathing;
comparing the breathing pattern identified with a target pattern specified in response to user input to the device; and
generating a further [[an]] instruction based on the comparing and conveying the further instruction to the user with the device.

detecting in real time a corresponding physiological condition of the user; and
generating a further [[an]] instruction, based on the breathing pattern and corresponding physiological condition, and conveying the further instruction to the user with the device.
